answer.summary: The API types check failed because the committed openaev-front/src/utils/api-types.d.ts is stale. The change added new enum values (SOURCE_CODE, CODE_REPOSITORY, CI_CD_PIPELINE, PACKAGE_REGISTRY, SOFTWARE_PACKAGE, CODE_OTHER) to the AssetBulkUpdateInput API types, but the regenerated file was not committed. Regenerating types with 'yarn generate-types-from-api' and committing the result should fix it; a re-run will fail the same way.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
